teraswap-self._comment: Strictest degrade (our own infra) but slow to DISABLE: 5 consecutive HTTP-level failures spanning >= 5 min. Transport errors on the probe are infra and never count (fix/monitor-self-source-alerts).

1inch._comment: High-volume source, tolerate more transient failures

cowswap._comment: Higher quorum tolerance due to batch auction surplus capture mechanics. Failure thresholds at defaults (post-incident heightened monitoring removed 2026-04-17, see INC-2026-04-14-001).

server-rpc._comment: Probed every 5th tick (~5 min) per chain via the server resolver; applies to server-rpc:<chainId>.
